text: Assumption: StopOffer is typically called during shutdown or during temporary inactivity of the validation — is this correct?

norm: stopoffer is typically called during shutdown or during temporary inactivity of the validation
assumption: StopOffer is typically called during shutdown or during temporary inactivity of the validation.
rationale: The specification describes the suspension of message forwarding, but does not define specific lifecycle phases of the caller.
